Any pipeline model task initiated by the interface uses Chapter 06. The GUI transport does not confer a Gemini-only execution role; interface prose cannot assert completion, select trusted identity or mutate controller authority.

requirements.requirement: Controller transactions are the sole state authority. Each job has immutable request identity, workflow/parent relationship and kind; every executable attempt receives a fresh attempt ID, increasing fence, lease, worker/seat and captured route. Idempotent resubmission of the same ID/payload returns its existing workflow; different payload reuse is rejected. Workflow roots summarize children and do not consume an execution seat merely by existing.

requirements.requirement: Use SQLite WAL, `synchronous=NORMAL`, `busy_timeout=5000` and atomic `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` claims. Default lease is 1,800 seconds, supported maximum 3,600; heartbeat interval is at most five seconds and at most one-third of the lease. Do no inference, external retrieval or slow filesystem/subprocess operation inside a write transaction. Read-only monitors have no mutation authority.

requirements.requirement: Every transition leaving active execution clears both lease owner and expiry in the same transaction. Late zombie results, duplicate differing outputs, sibling identity claims and missing receipt bindings are rejected by controller checks and database constraints. Identical accepted completion replay is idempotent. Cleanup uncertainty retains the physical reservation/quarantine; it never frees a possibly live seat.

requirements.requirement: Availability waits are distinct from ordinary execution failures. Default ordinary failure budget is three; exhaustion leaves a terminal poison-pill hold. Dispatch, routing cycle/time and repair budgets are separate. Scheduler progress is not equivalent to completed work. Crash recovery reconciles launch, cleanup, output and integration journals without duplicate acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Snapshot a registered Git project and capture allowed source/test paths, exact baseline commit, image/test policy and governing execution contract. `CODE_PLAN` produces an SRS skeleton/chapters, requirements, reciprocal acceptance/test traceability, acyclic `graph.json`/`graph.mmd`, `FractureManifest.json` and WBS leaf groups. The number 20 SHALL NOT limit leaves, coding batches, Codex or Agy. Groups remain bounded by explicit input/context safety limits. Each SRS/chapter is at most 400 lines; each leaf has one implementation target and a planned 20–100-line context. Every requirement and criterion is covered.

requirements.requirement: The controller calculates and stores score/rationale from task content; submitted model, score, tier or identity fields confer no authority. Current deterministic scoring starts at one, adds two for non-chapter task kinds, one per estimated-token threshold crossed (512/2,048/8,192), requirements threshold (4/12), dependency threshold (1/4), work breadth threshold (3/8) and distinct risk-group threshold (1/3), then caps at ten. Estimates are scheduling heuristics, not measured intelligence or tokenizer output. Version/hash the captured policy.

requirements.requirement: Attempt the exact tier order above for every model job, without exceptions. Busy reservation, unavailable provider, quota, auth, backlog or capability incompatibility advances to the next eligible candidate; record the actual reason. If every candidate is unavailable, persist exponential backoff (default 30 seconds, cap 600, ±20% deterministic jitter), then restart at the preferred model. No invented complexity-10 third route, paid API fallback, silent model alias, fixed-model override or tight resubmission loop.

Optional reviewed provider/model/effort/shared-pool operational limits may be lower than measured capabilities but SHALL be labelled configuration, not provider facts; default model/pool reservations have no artificial one/two cap. Current live admission limits govern new attempts, with their own captured admission-policy digest; an older task policy does not retain retired default one/two caps. Immutable task model order and already active reservations remain evidence-bound. Hardware admission and actual provisioned isolated identities still bound execution. Backlog, quota and cooldown observations distinguish actual evidence from assumptions. Never report remaining credits from a concurrency counter.

requirements.requirement: Use one configurable hardware admission ceiling across native attempts and Docker `PREPARING`/prepared/active reservations. The conservative initial setting is four until the host is measured; it is not a universal provider maximum. Increasing configured capacity requires sufficient provisioned isolated identities and measured resource headroom. SQLite admission and the Docker registry reconcile under one shared lock. Internal helpers/subagents cannot create unaccounted inference; every task is submitted and Chapter 06 routed. Pressure may lower capacity to zero and retries cannot override it.
owner_decisions: Hardware capacity is configurable; initial four seats await actual host measurements.
requirements.remediation: Run retained physical Windows/native subscription acceptance for this clause; attach exact revision/hash receipts.

requirements.requirement: Collect actual CPU utilization/count/temperature, available RAM, Windows commit headroom, GPU utilization/VRAM/temperature, required-volume free space and disk throughput/IOPS. Missing required sensors cause a visible admission hold, never a zero-valued healthy reading. CPU-only/sensor exceptions require an explicitly configured host profile and cannot claim the omitted guarantee.

requirements.remediation: Run retained physical Windows/native subscription acceptance for this clause; attach exact revision/hash receipts.

requirements.requirement: CPU/RAM admission bands scale within the configured hardware ceiling: below 30% CPU/>16 GiB free admits full configured capacity, below 50%/>8 GiB floor(3N/4), below 70%/>4 GiB floor(N/2), below 85%/>2 GiB floor(N/4), each with a minimum of one for positive configured N, otherwise zero. Further bound seats by measured memory/commit reserves, physical CPUs, per-attempt caps and available isolated identities. At initial four seats these bands remain 4/3/2/1. Reserve the larger permitted native/container memory cap per seat; do not subtract already measured RAM-disk allocation twice.
owner_decisions: Hardware capacity is configurable; initial four seats await actual host measurements.
requirements.remediation: Run retained physical Windows/native subscription acceptance for this clause; attach exact revision/hash receipts.

requirements.requirement: Default protections: CPU pause/critical 95%/99%; CPU temperature 85/95°C; GPU temperature 85/92°C; VRAM throttle above 80%, pause at 90%, sustained critical at 98%; free RAM reserve/critical 1,024/256 MiB; free commit 6,144/512 MiB; disk reserve/critical 512/128 MiB; disk I/O pause above 120 MiB/s or 4,000 IOPS. These are configurable protective defaults, not invented historic host measurements. Immediate thermal/critical reserve trips override state gating; sustained pressure confirms after five seconds. Recovery requires ten healthy seconds and three samples, increasing by one seat.
owner_decisions: Hardware capacity is configurable; initial four seats await actual host measurements.
requirements.remediation: Run retained physical Windows/native subscription acceptance for this clause; attach exact revision/hash receipts.

requirements.requirement: Before resuming a native child, verify its Windows Job Object limits: aggregate 2,048 MiB memory, 20% CPU rate and 16 processes by default, kill-on-close, E-core affinity and BelowNormal priority. Resolve E cores from actual topology rather than assume `0x00FF0000`. Warden itself uses verified E-core/BelowNormal scheduling. Set no-window/new-process-group flags and separate 100–500 ms launch/poll jitter. Node old-space is at most 512 MiB; this is not a total process/heap cap and does not govern Rust/Bun.
owner_decisions: Hardware capacity is configurable; initial four seats await actual host measurements.

Required native acceptance includes <15% actual desktop-heap allocation use and a 48-hour handle/resource stability run. USER/GDI counts cannot substitute for desktop-heap used/capacity evidence. Emergency teardown verifies physical descendants/container removal before any reservation is released.

Count the complete encoded/XML-wrapped context against its budget and escape `<oracle_directive>` content. Insufficient core capacity is a failure, never silent eviction.

Drain→set context→ack is serialized; acknowledge the exact generation. Repeated A→B→A must deliver the second A, while stale acknowledgments cannot erase newer context. Preserve delivery state through restart.

requirements.requirement: Strictly more than 500 events per rolling second trips the velocity breaker immediately even during `IN_PROGRESS`, bypassing normal state gates. Asynchronously stop monitoring/rogue process trees via native Job Objects, verify cleanup, then fence/reap affected jobs into `FAILED` or `PENDING_RETRY` with handles/locks released. Unrelated task failure is not a global collapse.

requirements.requirement: Adopt the existing ImDisk RAM volume at `R:\`, configured as 8 GiB and created automatically by the owner's Windows startup task. Verify actual driver/device/NTFS backing and capacity before use, then create protected per-slot scratch there. Existing ImDisk AWE and VM backing are both eligible after physical verification; VM is explicitly pageable and cannot be described as nonpageable physical AWE memory. New managed directory mounts default to AWE. Setup requiring administration occurs once; boot-time waiting, reattestation and scratch/ACL reconstruction are automatic. Never format, detach or silently recreate an adopted volume. Legacy verified directory mounts remain supported as explicit mappings. Safe online resizing is optional only when driver capability and volume quiescence are demonstrated; otherwise use the existing fixed volume and visible resource holds without repeated user setup.
owner_decisions: Adopt existing R: 8 GiB volume; one-time setup and automatic startup.
requirements.remediation: Run retained physical Windows/native subscription acceptance for this clause; attach exact revision/hash receipts.

requirements.requirement: For new controller-managed directory mounts, preserve original persistent contents before mounting, require an empty validated target and reject unknown reparse points. The owner-authorized existing R: drive is an explicit adoption case: physically attest it, preserve its contents and establish the protected lifecycle ledger without recreating it. Per-slot workspaces and caches live on RAM with exact worker ACLs; persistent provider login profiles and controller state remain outside scratch. Never treat a path string, junction or driver name alone as backing evidence.
owner_decisions: Adopt existing R: 8 GiB volume; one-time setup and automatic startup.
requirements.remediation: Run retained physical Windows/native subscription acceptance for this clause; attach exact revision/hash receipts.

requirements.requirement: Maintain a persistent prepared-container pool managed by the protected controller. Cold `create`/`start` occurs only in bounded background replenishment. Persist bounded FIFO profile requests and replenish under shared admission. Preserve healthy unused prepared containers across controller restart/graceful stop, but reattest engine identity, ownership, policy, readiness and expiry before adoption. Remove incompatible/expired/orphaned entries. Idle warm inventory must yield seats to runnable native work so it cannot monopolize all configured capacity.
